audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side reads 'Skill' on rows 0,2,3,4 while content win[N]/packet.levelChart read Blitzcrank, Leona, Leona, Leona for those rows.
audit.why: Leona has no gap-closer before level 3 (Zenith Blade), so level-1 hook punishes any step-up; once Zenith Blade plus Shield of Daybreak comes online her stun chain out-engages the telegraphed hook through level 5, then Solar Flare at 6 gives her a second AoE stun the single knock-up can't answer.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0,2,3,4].side to match win[N] and rewrote each .why; rows 1,5,6 already agreed with Skill and were left alone.

audit.why: Content layer correctly identifies Solar Flare (R, 90/75/60s) as her level-6 spike and first item as the point Blitzcrank tanks through her all-in.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags no cooldown-sequencing advice, breakdown.cooldowns has no digit, 8 fields misgender Leona as 'his/he', and two Do's/Don'ts bullets paste tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles (all in lintFindings).
audit.why: Zenith Blade (E) is 12-6s, Shield of Daybreak (Q) is a flat 5s, Solar Flare (R) is 90/75/60s. Leona is she/her per champ-gender data.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with real numbers and sequencing language, fixed all 8 misgendered fields, rewrote the two bled bullets to match their own titles.

edits.before: The hook threat IS level 1 — their duo plays behind minions or pays immediately.
edits.after: Before Zenith Blade exists, Leona has no gap-closer — Rocket Grab punishes any step-up.

edits.before: Full kit: W the flank angles — the hook from fog is the lane's scariest sentence.
edits.after: Her Zenith Blade plus Shield of Daybreak stun chain out-engages your telegraphed hook.

edits.before: Zone with the arm — every minion they hide behind is tempo you taxed for free.
edits.after: Her multi-CC all-in — E root into Q stun — out-locks your single knock-up.

edits.before: Static Field online — the silence finishes what the fist started.
edits.after: Solar Flare gives her a second AoE stun your one knock-up can't answer.

edits.before: - Leona Zenith Blade: matchup-defining — The blade root starts every Leona chain — stand behind minions while it is up. It writes your spacing rules. - W Overdrive is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Zenith Blade (E) is down 12-6s by rank and starts every chain — stand behind minions while it's up. - Shield of Daybreak (Q) resets her autos on a 5s cooldown for the stun. - Solar Flare (R) refreshes at 90/75/60s and is her second, game-deciding stun.
